/* cppi::7dbad385fda97d2958880853065558ddcf5f7f8d0cbe709b698c0fe49bbf0311 */
/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( select cast(st.business_date as date) as business_date,
	round(st.abor_transaction_number) as abor_transaction_number,
	st.abor_security_id,
	es.sedol,
	es.isin,
	es.cusip,
	es.esm_incorp_country_code,
	es.security_name_id,
	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	st.model_portfolio_id,
	st.business_transaction_code,
	st.settlement_currency,
	cast(st.trade_date as date) as trade_date,
	cast(st.payment_date as date) as payment_date,
	st.nominal,
	st.nominal_basis,
	st.elementary_transaction_code,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
	st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
	st.reconciliation_status,
	st.created_date,
	ep.party_id,
	ep.epm_party_name,
	st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
	st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
	st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
	st.external_short_tag,
	st.settlement_date,
	st.quotation_currency,
	st.number_of_units,
	case when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') and st.abor_security_name like '%CAD%' then 'Y'
	when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') then 'N'
	end cross_deal_indicator,
	st.settlement_location,
	es.esm_country_code,
	rec.country_ref_code,
	rcc_exchange_country.country_name esm_country_name,
	rcc_incorp_country.country_name esm_incorp_country_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	ss.abor_security_group_name,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	rcc_trade_country.country_name country_ref_name,
	rcc.currency_name quotation_currency_name,
	st.price price_qc,
	st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency price_pc,
	st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.investment_type_name,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
	st.portfolio_id,
	st.ibor_reason,
	ss.abor_coupon_rate,
	st.dividend_per_share,
	st.borrowing_account,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency
from (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
	from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
	where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio )
	and st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_party_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from party.enterprise_party
) ep
	on st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id
	and ep.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	and ss.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities )
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and rec.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country
	on es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
	and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
	and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
	)sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
	select abor_transaction_number,
    		business_date,
    		transaction_cancellation_flag,
    		trade_date,
    		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
 	from trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
 	group by abor_transaction_number,
    	business_date,
    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
    	trade_date
	) stc
	on st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
	--and st.business_date = stc.business_date
	and st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
	and st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
left join reference.reference_currency_codes rcc
	on st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
	and rcc.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes )
where st.rn = 1 ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-02'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-02'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

with 
  TOTAL_PV as
    (
      select fact.analytic_value as pv
      from radar_reporting_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact,
           radar_reporting_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node
      where
        fact.business_date = '2025-05-30'
        and fact.business_date = node.business_date 
        AND fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
        AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
        AND fact.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
        AND node.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
        AND node.node_level = 1
    ),
  WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI AS
    (SELECT DISTINCT    
        parent.party_name,
        parent.rtg_final,
        COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code) AS country,
        parent.gics_sector,
        parent.is_government,
        parent.is_provincial,
        pos.investment_department,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name, PARENT.rtg_final ) AS ce_by_party_by_rating,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name, pos.investment_department ) AS ce_by_party_by_dept,
        SUM( COALESCE(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARENT.party_name ) AS ce_by_party,
        CASE
          WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN pv * 0.1
          WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
              AND upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 'CANADA') THEN 0  
          WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1  
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) then pv * 0.1
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.075
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.05
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) THEN pv * 0.03
          when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) then pv * 0.025  
          else -2 
        end as limit
      from
        radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
        total_pv,
        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
      left join radar_reporting_prod.ref_country ref_country on parent.domicile_country_code = ref_country.alpha_2_code and ref_country.business_date = parent.business_date
      where
        fact.business_date = '2025-05-30'
        and fact.business_date = child.business_date
        and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
        and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
        AND FACT.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
    )
  SELECT
    party_name,
    coalesce( rtg_final, 'NR' ) as rtg_final,
    country,
    CASE
      WHEN gics_sector = 'Telecommunication Services' then 'Telecom Services'
      ELSE COALESCE(gics_sector, 'Unknown')
    END AS gics_sector,
    investment_department,
    ce_by_party / 1000000 AS credit_exposure,
    case
      when limit > 0 then limit / 1000000
      else 0
    end as limit,
    case
      when limit > 0 then round( ce_by_party / limit * 100, 1 )
      else 0
    END AS limit_util
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT
        party_name,
        min(rtg_final) over (partition by party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS rtg_final,
        country,
        gics_sector,
        is_government,
        is_provincial,
        MIN(investment_department) OVER (PARTITION BY party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS investment_department,
        ce_by_party,
        min(limit) over (partition by party_name ORDER BY ce_by_party_by_rating DESC) AS limit
      FROM
        WF_VW_CREDIT_EXPOSURE_MINI
    )
    where limit > 0 AND round( ce_by_party / limit * 100, 1 ) > 100
  order by ce_by_party desc

/* cppi::376aa090a44ffe64e309c8995b25c5ae97eb58f23748aeabeb2eebea5ad1b87d */
SELECT 
  pos.*,
  sector."Sector Final",
  country."Country Final",
  sector.cppib_country_of_exposure_code, 
  dv01.dv01,
  cs01.cs01, 
  (top_level.top_level_pv*pos.benchmark_constituent_weight) as pv

FROM risk_prod.benchmark_positions_view pos

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            business_date, 
            pv AS top_level_pv
        FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv
        WHERE business_date = '2025-05-30'
          AND benchmark_name = 'ATP CORE'
          AND node_level = 1
          AND run_id = 'ATP_CORE'
    ) top_level
        ON top_level.business_date = pos.business_date

-- Join sector classification
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    cppib_sec_id, 
    cppib_country_of_exposure_code, 
    cppib_sector_classification_name_1 AS "Sector Final"
  FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
  WHERE business_date = date'2025-05-30'
) sector
  ON pos.id_cppib_security = CAST(sector.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)

-- Join country codes
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    country_code, 
    country_name AS "Country Final"
  FROM reference.reference_country_codes
  WHERE business_date = date'2025-05-30'
) country
  ON country.country_code = sector.cppib_country_of_exposure_code

-- Join DV01
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    benchmark_pos_id,
    SUM(dv01_value) AS dv01
  FROM risk_prod.benchmark_pos_calc_dv01
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(dv01) AS t(dv01_value)
  WHERE business_date = '2025-05-30'
  GROUP BY benchmark_pos_id
) dv01
  ON dv01.benchmark_pos_id = pos.benchmark_pos_id

-- Join CS01
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    benchmark_pos_id,
    SUM(cs01_value) AS cs01
  FROM risk_prod.benchmark_pos_calc_cs01
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cs01) AS t(cs01_value)
  WHERE business_date = '2025-05-30'
  GROUP BY benchmark_pos_id
) cs01
  ON cs01.benchmark_pos_id = pos.benchmark_pos_id

-- Final filters
WHERE pos.business_date = '2025-05-30'
  AND pos.benchmark_name = 'ATP CORE'
  AND pos.category LIKE '%Balanc%'

	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by

	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_uat
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_uat.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='ACPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-05-30'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END

WITH

    select
        max(publish_timestamp) as latest_publish_timestamp,
        max(business_date) as end_date,
        date_add('day', -10, max(business_date)) as start_date
    from
        credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline

record_counts as (
    select
        publish_timestamp,
        business_date,
        count(*) as number_of_recs
    from 
        credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline
        join business_dates_range
            on business_date between start_date and end_date
    group by
        publish_timestamp,
        business_date
),
max_and_avg_prev_10_days as (
    select
        avg(number_of_recs)+avg(number_of_recs)*0.2 as daily_max_rec_number,
        avg(number_of_recs)-avg(number_of_recs)*0.2 as daily_min_rec_number
    from 
        record_counts
        join business_dates_range
            on business_date >= start_date 
                and business_date <= end_date
)

select 
    *
from 
    record_counts

SELECT ds.* FROM ( -- Final SQL: Department/Strategy/Program view with Core Pool AUM and % of core, filtered to dates after 2020-04-01

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        r.*,
        date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q3'
            ELSE cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar) || 'Q4'
        END AS fiscal_quarter_key
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics r
    WHERE r.portfolio_type = 'IP'
      AND r.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
      AND r.hierarchy_level IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'STRATEGY', 'PROGRAM')
      AND (
            r.analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
            OR (
                r.analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
                AND r.confidence_level = 0.95
            )
        )
      AND date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= date '2020-04-01'
),

quarter_end_dates AS (
    SELECT fiscal_quarter_key, MAX(parsed_date) AS quarter_end_date
    FROM base_data
    WHERE month(parsed_date) IN (3, 6, 9, 12)
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter_key
),

core_pool AS (
    SELECT 
        date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        SUM(market_value_qc) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM risk_prod.ref_fund_unitization
    WHERE fund_code = 'CORE'
    GROUP BY date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
),

filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        d.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date THEN 
                'F' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 3, 2) || ' ' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 5, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        cp.core_pool_aum
    FROM base_data d
    LEFT JOIN quarter_end_dates q 
        ON d.fiscal_quarter_key = q.fiscal_quarter_key AND d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date
    LEFT JOIN core_pool cp 
        ON d.parsed_date = cp.parsed_date
),

department_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )

/* cppi::6eb48740f211b527e186953a20736ca738ea55d6a3c2f79fce005f655c0d0622 */

SELECT ds.* FROM ( with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg ) ds LIMIT 0

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 10:00:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

    sec.reporting_id_code as deal_code,
    sec.reporting_id_name as deal_name,
    sum(ci.mv_rc) as mv_rc,
    sum(ci.pnl_rc) as pnl_rc,
    sum(ci.pnl_lc) as pnl_lc,
    sum(ci.net_cf_rc) as net_cf_rc
from (
        select business_date,
            aggregation_level_1 as mp_id,
            aggregation_level_3 as sec_id,
            market_value_reporting_currency as mv_rc,
            period_result_node_by_node_reporting_currency as pnl_rc,
            period_result_node_by_node_local as pnl_lc,
            net_cash_flow_reporting_currency as net_cf_rc
        from scd_prod.performance_seclvl_latest psl
            inner join (
                select model_portfolio_id,
                    investment_department_code
                from reference.scd_model_portfolio
                where business_date = (
                        select max(business_date)
                        from reference.scd_model_portfolio
                    )
            ) mp on psl.aggregation_level_1 = mp.model_portfolio_id
        where psl.business_date > '2023-06-30'
            and mp.investment_department_code = 'CREDIT'
    ) ci
    inner join (
        select business_date,
            scd_security_key_id,
            abor_security_id,
            reporting_id_code,
            reporting_id_name
        from reference.scd_securities
        where business_date = (
                select max(business_date)
                from reference.scd_securities
            )
            and reporting_id_code is not null
    ) sec on ci.sec_id = sec.abor_security_id
group by ci.business_date,
    sec.reporting_id_code,
    sec.reporting_id_name
order by ci.business_date,
    sec.reporting_id_code,
    sec.reporting_id_name

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025

		AND hour between 21 and 22

	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 21:48:36'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

/* cppi::58f8badf9d0983f4eee1a094db21c0c0c98306ab0596756e7240b42a66e0f0a2 */
SELECT h.model_portfolio_id AS MPDEFS_MP,
 h.abor_security_id AS SECURITIES_SECSHORT,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALP,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number < 0 THEN -1 * h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALS,
 t.party_name AS PARTNERS_BROKERNAME,
 t.trade_date AS SECURITIES_ISSDATE,
 h.abor_maturity_date AS PFCKEYRATIOS_MATDATE,
 h.portfolio_id AS PORTFOLIOS_POR,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.quotation_currency_code ELSE NULL END) AS HOLKEYS_QUOCURP,
 h.security_group_id AS SECGROUPS_SECGRP,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number < 0 THEN h.quotation_currency_code ELSE NULL END) AS HOLKEYS_QUOCURS,
 SUM(h.unrealised_pnl_book_currency_portfolio_currency + h.unrealised_pnl_book_security_portfolio_currency) AS PFCKEYRATIOS_CLEANVALPCT,
 h.portfolio_group_name AS PORTGROUPS_PORGRP
 from holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 JOIN (
 select DISTINCT t.abor_security_id , t.trade_date, p.party_name
 from trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 join reference.scd_party_issuer p on  t.counterparty_id = p.scd_party_id
 where 1=1
 and t.business_transaction_code in ('SellFXFwdDbd','BuyFXFwdDbd','InitHoldNom','InitHold')
 and t.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
 ) t ON h.abor_security_id = t.abor_security_id
 WHERE h.business_date = '2025-05-30'
 and (t.party_name not LIKE 'INTERNAL CPTY%'
 or (trim(h.portfolio_id) = 'S PARENT' and t.party_name LIKE 'INTERNAL CPTY%'))
 and h.security_group_id in ('FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF')
 and h.balance_nominal_number != 0
 GROUP BY
 h.model_portfolio_id,
 h.abor_security_id,
 t.party_name,
 t.trade_date,
 h.abor_maturity_date,
 h.portfolio_id,
 h.security_group_id,
 h.portfolio_group_name
 order by h.abor_maturity_date

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( -- Final SQL: Department/Strategy/Program view with Core Pool AUM and % of core, filtered to dates after 2020-04-01

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        r.*,
        date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q3'
            ELSE cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar) || 'Q4'
        END AS fiscal_quarter_key
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics r
    WHERE r.portfolio_type = 'IP'
      AND r.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
      AND r.hierarchy_level IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'STRATEGY', 'PROGRAM')
      AND (
            r.analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
            OR (
                r.analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
                AND r.confidence_level = 0.95
            )
        )
      AND date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= date '2020-04-01'
),

quarter_end_dates AS (
    SELECT fiscal_quarter_key, MAX(parsed_date) AS quarter_end_date
    FROM base_data
    WHERE month(parsed_date) IN (3, 6, 9, 12)
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter_key
),

core_pool AS (
    SELECT 
        date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        SUM(market_value_qc) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM risk_prod.ref_fund_unitization
    WHERE fund_code = 'CORE'
    GROUP BY date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
),

filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        d.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date THEN 
                'F' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 3, 2) || ' ' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 5, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        cp.core_pool_aum
    FROM base_data d
    LEFT JOIN quarter_end_dates q 
        ON d.fiscal_quarter_key = q.fiscal_quarter_key AND d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date
    LEFT JOIN core_pool cp 
        ON d.parsed_date = cp.parsed_date
),

department_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL')
),

department_final AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN department IN ('Credit Investments', 'Private Equity', 'Real Assets') 
            THEN pv / NULLIF(core_pool_aum, 0)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_of_core
    FROM department_agg
),

cppib_all_row AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS department,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter
),

strategy_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        CASE 
            WHEN strategy = 'Real_Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
            ELSE strategy
        END AS display_strategy,
        'strategy' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'STRATEGY'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, strategy
),

program_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        program AS display_strategy,
        'program' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, program
)

-- Final output
SELECT * FROM department_final
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cppib_all_row
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM strategy_agg

                'F' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 3, 2) || ' ' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 5, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        cp.core_pool_aum
    FROM base_data d
    LEFT JOIN quarter_end_dates q 
        ON d.fiscal_quarter_key = q.fiscal_quarter_key AND d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date
    LEFT JOIN core_pool cp 
        ON d.parsed_date = cp.parsed_date
),

department_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL')
),

department_final AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN department IN ('Credit Investments', 'Private Equity', 'Real Assets') 
            THEN pv / NULLIF(core_pool_aum, 0)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_of_core
    FROM department_agg
),

cppib_all_row AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS department,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter
),

strategy_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        CASE 
            WHEN strategy = 'Real_Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
            ELSE strategy
        END AS display_strategy,
        'strategy' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'STRATEGY'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, strategy
),

program_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        program AS display_strategy,
        'program' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, program
)

-- Final output
SELECT * FROM department_final
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cppib_all_row
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM strategy_agg
UNION ALL

WITH 
	params as (
		select
			-10 as days_interval,
			20 as allowed_deviation_pct
	),
	business_dates_range as (
		select
			max(ccp.business_date) as end_date,
			date_add('day', 
					(select days_interval from params), 
					max(ccp.business_date)) as start_date
		from
			credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline as ccp
	),
	business_dates_latest_timestamps as (
	    select 
	        ccp.business_date,
	        max(ccp.publish_timestamp) as publish_timestamp
	    from
	        credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline as ccp
	        join business_dates_range as bdr
	            on ccp.business_date between bdr.start_date and bdr.end_date
	    group by 
	        ccp.business_date
	),
	record_counts as (
		select
			ccp.publish_timestamp,
			ccp.business_date,
			count(*) as number_of_recs
		from 
			credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline as ccp
			join business_dates_latest_timestamps as bdlt
				on ccp.business_date =  bdlt.business_date
					and ccp.publish_timestamp = bdlt.publish_timestamp
		group by
			ccp.publish_timestamp,
			ccp.business_date
	),
	rec_count_daily_chg_limits as (
		select
			avg(rc.number_of_recs)
				-avg(rc.number_of_recs)*(select allowed_deviation_pct from params)/100.0 as daily_min_rec_number,
			avg(rc.number_of_recs)
				+avg(rc.number_of_recs)*(select allowed_deviation_pct from params)/100.0 as daily_max_rec_number
		from 
			record_counts as rc
			join business_dates_range as bdr
				on rc.business_date >= bdr.start_date 
					and rc.business_date < bdr.end_date
	)
select 
    case when rc.number_of_recs < rcdcl.daily_min_rec_number
                or rc.number_of_recs > rcdcl.daily_max_rec_number
        then 1 
        else 0 
        end as is_out_of_bounds
from 
    record_counts as rc
    cross join rec_count_daily_chg_limits as rcdcl
    join business_dates_range as bdr on
        rc.business_date = bdr.end_date
    join business_dates_latest_timestamps as bdlt on
        rc.business_date = bdlt.business_date
        and rc.publish_timestamp = bdlt.publish_timestamp

            security_no,

/* QuickSight 4ab8ef1a-5fda-47b6-8d1d-0e15c4256ec3 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

		, case

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

			union all

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				, pnl_4yp_lc

				or (

					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	/* DATA PULLED:

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'

		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'

			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (

		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'

			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency

	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		(
			case
				when node_level = 1 then 'CPPIB-ALL'
				when node_level = 2 then 'DEPARTMENT'
				when node_level = 3 then 'STRATEGY'
				when node_level = 4 then 'PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 5 then 'SUB-PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 6 then 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO' else 'UNKNOWN'
			end
		) as hierarchy_level,
		'RISK' as HIERARCHY_TYPE,
		node_name,
		'' as account,
		'' as pool,
		parent_node_id,
		investment_dept,
		investment_strat,
		program,
		sub_program,
		model_portfolio
	from radar_reporting_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk
	where business_date = '2025-05-30'
),
classification_secno as (select inst_id, cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industry_sector_name  
			from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite class
			join risk_uat.dim_inst i on i.security_number = class.abor_security_number and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
			where i.business_date = '2025-05-30' and class.esm_instrument_type = 'abor_security_number'
			union
			select inst_id, cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industry_sector_name  
			from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite class 
			join risk_uat.dim_inst i on i.cppib_security_id = cast(class.cppib_sec_id as varchar) and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
			where i.business_date = '2025-05-30' and class.esm_instrument_type = 'cppib_sec_id'
)
select 
	(
		case
			when dpi.portfolio_type in ('IP', 'CASH_FOR_BENEFIT', 'ACPP_CFB') then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH' then replace(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 'CPPSECID')

	) as "position_key",
	currency.iso_currency_code "DV01_currency",

	curve_type.curve_type_value "DV01_curve_type",
	dv01.data_source "DV01_data_source",
	term.term_value "DV01_tenor",
	coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * dv01.final_value "DV01_cad_value",

	dv01.initial_value,
	dv01.override_source,
	dv01.override_value,
	dv01.portfolio_type,
	dv01.scaling_type,
	dpi.maturity_date,
	dpi.pos_short_desc as "position_description",
	rh.model_portfolio as "scd_model_portfolio",
	rh.investment_dept,
	rh.investment_strat as "investment_strategy",
	rh.program as "investment_program",
	rh.sub_program as "investment_sub_program",
	dpi.cppib_product_type as "product_type",
	dpi.security_group_name as "product_group",
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.party_name is not null then i_rle.party_name
			when l1_rle.party_name is not null then l1_rle.party_name
			when mi_rle.party_name is not null then mi_rle.party_name
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_party_name,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.gics_sector is not null then i_rle.gics_sector
			when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector 
			when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
			when mi_rle.gics_sector is not null then mi_rle.gics_sector
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_gics_sector,
	cpr.rating_value as "issuer_final_rating",
	csr.rating_value as "inst_final_rating",
	(
		case 
			when dpi.isin is not null then dpi.isin 
			when inst1.isin is not null then inst1.isin
			else inst2.isin
		end
	) as isin,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.sedol is not null then dpi.sedol 
			when inst1.sedol is not null then inst1.sedol
			else inst2.sedol

			when inst1.cusip is not null then inst1.cusip
			else inst2.cusip

from radar_reporting_uat.fact_pos_calc_md dv01
	join radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_currency currency ON dv01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
	and dv01.business_date = currency.business_date
	join radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_term term ON dv01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
	and term.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'TERM'
	and dv01.business_date = term.business_date

	and curve.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE'

	and dv01.business_date = dpi.business_date
	left join radar_reporting_uat.fact_fx_rate fx ON currency.iso_currency_code = fx.to_currency
	and currency.chron_id = fx.chron_id
	and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
	and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'

	left join radar_reporting_uat.dim_inst inst1 on inst1.inst_id = dpi.inst1_id

	left join radar_reporting_uat.cppib_security_rating csr on csr.cppib_sec_id = cast(dpi.cppib_security_id as int)

where curve_type.curve_type_value = 'ZERO'
	and dv01.calc_type = 'DV01'
	and dv01.business_date = '2025-05-30'
	and dv01.final_value <> 0
union all

	and dv01.business_date = curve.business_date

	and dv01.business_date = curve_type.business_date

	and dv01.business_date = fx.business_date
where dv01.business_date = '2025-05-30'

                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id

            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499

        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown
FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'parent' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p

                 SUM(

                                 OR

                                      )

                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id

                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND

            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499

            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit

        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold

            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'

    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 10000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,
    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown
FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'parent' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY

        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit

         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p

                                      )

                     WHERE
                       parent.business_date = sibling.business_date

                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'

     child_level_exp_limits AS

             SELECT

                             ELSE 0

                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0

                     ) AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_repo_fi_limit) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
